games.title: 19YY
games.description: 19YY is a vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up developed by Ichikyu Wai Wai, EKORZ, and Elrayzeur for the Neo Geo MVS platform in 2022. Inspired by classic 1940s-style military arcade shooters, players pilot a twin-propeller fighter aircraft across ocean and air stages, shooting down waves of enemy planes and bosses while collecting power-ups and deploying screen-clearing bombs.

games.title: 1st Defence: The Final Upgrade
games.description:
1st Defence: The Final Upgrade is a 2026 tower-defense strategy game developed by theSEGAshop for the Neo Geo AES and MVS. Rather than focusing on the immediate movement and shooting action typical of many arcade games, it challenges players with a series of defensive scenarios in which planning and survival are central to success. The main campaign contains eight missions, while an Endless mode provides a continuing challenge beyond the fixed sequence.

The game also offers a two-player versus mode, adding direct competition to its single-player strategy gameplay. Persistent scoreboards allow players to compare their achievements across sessions, and memory-card support provides a way to retain progress. Multiple soundtracks accompany the action, making this an unusual strategy-focused addition to the Neo Geo homebrew library.
research_notes: The description follows the project brief and could not be cross-checked locally; the title screen of the ROM set shows the title 1st Defence: The Final Upgrade.
No version identifier is established.
Genre Tabletop is the closest standard label for a strategy game.

games.title: Seven Wonders Puzzles
games.description:
Seven Wonders Puzzles is a 2026 puzzle game by Eagle Software for the Neo Geo, combining several styles of logic and color-matching challenges within a journey through seven fantasy locations. Players encounter match-three boards, bubble-shooting stages and picture-logic puzzles, each requiring a different approach. Matching colored pieces can create cascades and special items, while bubble stages challenge players to aim shots, connect matching colors and rescue kittens trapped inside bubbles.

The adventure visits locations such as the Sky Garden, Crystal Canal, Moon Lighthouse and Coral Palace. Two cheerful cat guides, Mimi and Kiko, accompany the player through the colorful environments, reacting to successful combinations and completed challenges. Picture-logic puzzles use numerical clues to reveal hidden images, while stars, scores and collectible rewards encourage players to improve their results. Its pastel presentation, expressive characters and variety of puzzle styles give the game a distinctive identity among Neo Geo homebrew releases.
research_notes: The version 1.0.2 comes from the project brief; the local reference labels this ROM set only as v1, so the exact release could not be verified.
The features described could not be checked against this exact ROM release; earlier preview builds had fewer levels, so no total level count is stated.
Player count is not established.

games.title: Abyssal Infants
games.description: Abyssal Infants is a horizontally scrolling shooter by Kako Eimon, also developed for the Mega Drive and PlayStation. Guide a small creature through an organic underworld, firing at enemies while avoiding their projectiles. Slow movement helps with precise dodging, while a dash provides a faster way through danger; a second player can join the action.

games.title: Akai Katana
games.description: Akai Katana is a horizontal-scrolling bullet-hell shoot-'em-up developed and published by Cave for the Cave CV1000-D arcade hardware in 2010. Set in a parallel Taisho-era Japan powered by a mystical mineral called Bloodstone, players choose between three fighter-pilot teams who can switch dynamically between a traditional Fighter craft and a giant phantom-warrior Soul form, altering their attack patterns, bullet-canceling mechanics, and katana-based scoring system.

games.title: Akai Katana Unlimited

modifications.description: Removes the phantom Soul timer drain so players can remain in Soul form indefinitely and alters katana generation mechanics.

games.description: Akai Katana Unlimited is a gameplay modification of Cave's 2010 horizontal shoot-'em-up Akai Katana created by IAmTheChuckster. It removes the time limit on the phantom Soul transformation, allowing players to stay in Soul form continuously and experiment freely with the katana-summoning and bullet-reflection mechanics.

games.title: Arkanoid Deluxe (Game Corporation)
games.description: Arkanoid Deluxe is a modified edition of Taito's brick-breaking game for Game Corporation bootleg hardware. Move the paddle to keep the ball in play and clear the brick patterns.
research_notes: The hack author, release history and complete list of changes have not been independently established.

games.title: Clockwork Aquario
games.description: Clockwork Aquario is a two-player side-scrolling action platformer developed by Westone Bit Entertainment for the Sega System 18 arcade board. Originally planned for release in 1993, the project was cancelled after location testing and remained unreleased for nearly three decades before its prototype ROM was recovered and restored.

games.title: Arena 2
games.description:
Arena 2 is a 2026 competitive arena-action game created by Delarfab for the Neo Geo. One or two players battle in compact, single-screen arenas whose edges wrap around, allowing characters and projectiles to travel from one side of the playfield to the other. In Territory mode, moving across blocks and shooting them changes their ownership, with victory going to the player controlling the largest area when time expires. Duel mode instead rewards direct combat, where a single successful hit eliminates an opponent and ammunition must be recovered after use.

Players choose from three characters with different weapons: PIX fires paint projectiles and arrows, BOOMA uses a returning boomerang, and VOLT launches bouncing discs. Movement includes jumping, wall jumping, dodging and catching incoming shots. Power-ups and special events can change the arena through effects such as reversed gravity, temporary unlimited ammunition or rain that removes painted territory. Matches can be played against a friend or the computer.
research_notes: The exact release version of the ROM set is not established locally.
The description does not mention the Totem mode or additional arenas of later releases, since their presence in this ROM set is not verified.

games.title: Armed Police Batrider
games.description: Armed Police Batrider is a vertical-scrolling manic shoot-'em-up developed by Raizing and published by Eighting in 1998. Set in the futuristic crime-ridden island city of Gigantea, players assemble a three-character team from a large roster of Batrider pilots and guest characters from earlier Raizing titles such as Battle Garegga and Kingdom Grandprix, featuring dynamic rank control and dozens of hidden bosses.

games.title: Batsugun (Special Ver.)
games.description: Batsugun (Special Ver.) is an enhanced version of Toaplan's 1993 vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up Batsugun. It introduces a smaller player hitbox, a protective shield when leveling up weapons, a reworked scoring system, and multiple loops with bullet-canceling mechanics that helped define the modern manic shooter genre.

games.title: Battle Bakraid - Unlimited Version
games.description: Battle Bakraid - Unlimited Version is an updated release of Eighting's 1999 vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up Battle Bakraid. Built around high-scoring chain multipliers and boss-rush style aerial combat, Unlimited Version expands the game beyond the original training and normal courses with an extended nine-stage Advanced Course.

games.title: Battle Garegga (Zakk version, set 1)

modifications.description: Unlocks the Mahou Daisakusen guest characters without entering the selection code.
Prevents the starting rank from increasing across successive games.

games.description: Zakk's Battle Garegga patch makes the Mahou Daisakusen guest characters available immediately and prevents difficulty rank from accumulating between games. Players can start successive credits from the default rank without resetting the machine, while the original stages, weapons and scoring remain intact.

games.title: Blue and Red Fight the Robots
games.description: Blue and Red Fight the Robots is a fast-paced cooperative arcade platformer originally developed for the Amiga and ported to Neo Geo by Kaiju Wasp. Play solo or with a second player across 40 stages, zapping and stomping rogue robots, building combo chains, and rescuing the kidnapped pets Bernie and Dino.

games.title: Block Panic DX
games.description: Block Panic DX is a fast-paced action puzzle game developed by Blastar for the Neo Geo MVS platform and released on January 1, 2025. Players clear and rearrange falling blocks under time pressure across single-player and competitive modes.

games.title: Bubble Bobble Ultra

modifications.description: Reworks stage layouts and enemy placements across the 100 stages, mixing entirely redesigned layouts with layouts inspired by Super Bubble Bobble.
Changes the stage color palettes.

games.description: Penta Penguin's Bubble Bobble Ultra replaces the original game's 100 stages with a mixture of redesigned layouts and stages inspired by Super Bubble Bobble, with altered enemy arrangements and color palettes. Bub and Bob still trap enemies in bubbles and pop them to clear each room, alone or together.
research_notes: The differences between the two Ultra program revisions and the 2012 date assigned to the USA set remain unverified.

games.title: Project Neon Caravan Edition
games.description: Project Neon Caravan Edition is a pre-alpha score-attack demo of the homebrew vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up Project Neon developed by Team Fullset for the Neo Geo MVS in 2019. Designed in the tradition of classic caravan shooting competitions, it challenges players to achieve the highest possible score within a timed stage.

games.title: Captain Barrel
games.description: Captain Barrel is a homebrew arcade action game developed and published by Neo Byte Force Ltd for the Neo Geo MVS platform in 2024.

games.title: Century XI: The Road to 2030
games.description:
Century XI: Road to 2030 is a 2026 football game developed by Eagle Software for the Neo Geo, presenting a humorous alternative to international tournaments. Inspired by the atmosphere of 1990s arcade football, it features 48 fictional nations with their own team colors, flags, player rosters, chants and playing styles. The main Road to 2030 mode recreates a complete 64-match championship with group standings, knockout rounds, leading scorers, player suspensions and a trophy presentation. The competition culminates in a fictional Tokyo stadium called the Big Ramen Bowl.

Alongside the tournament, players can take part in exhibition matches, a shorter cup competition, two-player versus matches, penalty shootouts and training. On the field, the game combines passes, crosses, chips and charged shots with headers, volleys and overhead kicks. Goalkeepers can be controlled directly, while different control schemes and computer difficulty settings accommodate different playing styles. Comical commentary, animated goal celebrations, action replays and exaggerated referees give the game a playful identity distinct from realistic football simulations.
research_notes: The version 4.0.0 comes from the project brief; the ROM set was supplied locally and no release documentation is available locally, so the exact release could not be verified. Player count is not established.
Release status is beta because v4.0.0 is a publicly available work-in-progress release.
The description comes from developer-published material supplied with the project brief and was not checked against v4.0.0 specifically.

games.title: Chuckie Egg
games.description: Chuckie Egg is a platform game adapted by Arlasoft for arcade hardware in 2023. Climb ladders and jump between platforms to collect eggs while avoiding the birds patrolling the stage.

games.title: Codename: Blut Engel
games.description: Codename: Blut Engel is a homebrew horizontal shoot-'em-up developed by Blastar for the Neo Geo MVS platform, represented here by its September 5, 2018 revision.

games.title: Columns
games.description: Columns is an unofficial homebrew adaptation of Sega's tile-matching puzzle game created by Jeff Kurtz for the Neo Geo platform, where players align falling vertical triplets of colored jewels horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

games.title: Cotton 2 (English translation)

modifications.description: Translates the attract-mode prologue, character profiles, stage-continue hints, all story dialogue scenes (VS0-VS6), ending sequence (VS7), and staff roll into English.

games.description: Cotton 2 (English translation) is an English localization patch by Zanac (with help from Katrin and Danthrax) for Success's 1997 Sega ST-V cute-'em-up Cotton 2: Magical Night Dreams. Adapting the script and graphics from the Sega Saturn fan translation to native ST-V arcade hardware, it translates the attract-mode prologue scroll, character profiles, continue-screen hints across all seven stages, in-game story cutscenes, and the ending credits into English while preserving original arcade gameplay timing.

games.title: Cotton Boomerang (English translation)

modifications.description: Translates stage results, character selection panels, and character names in attract mode into English, and adds a translation credit under the title logo. Uses the translated Japanese mode with every ST-V BIOS region.

games.description: Cotton Boomerang (English translation) is an English localization patch by Zanac for Success's 1998 Sega ST-V cute-'em-up Cotton Boomerang: Magical Night Dreams. Translating the remaining Japanese text using the English font from the Cotton 2 localization, it translates the character dialogues on the stage result screens, the weapon and shot select panels across all eight playable characters, and full character names in the attract mode, while replacing the title logo subtitle with a translation credit. The patch also forces the game to run in its translated Japanese mode across all ST-V BIOS regions, resolving export-mode omissions and typos while preserving original arcade gameplay and mechanics.

games.title: The Crystal Maze - Now Featuring Ocean Zone
Crossed Swords 2 (full CD music)
games.description: Crossed Swords 2 (full CD music) is a Neo Geo MVS conversion of ADK's Neo Geo CD action RPG by pierpa86. Unlike earlier cartridge conversions that omitted or altered the redbook audio, this release adapts the complete CD soundtrack to the YM2610 sound chip while keeping the original stereo sound effects intact.

modifications.description: Integrates the full Neo Geo CD soundtrack converted to run on the YM2610 hardware while preserving stereo sound effects.

games.title: Cyborg Force
games.description: Cyborg Force is a homebrew run-and-gun action game developed and published by Neo Byte Force for the Neo Geo MVS platform in 2023.

games.title: DoDonPachi (Ship Color Hack)

modifications.description: Adds a choice of 64 player ship palettes during ship selection.
Removes background music while retaining sound effects.

games.description: Olifante's hack of the Japanese arcade version of DoDonPachi adds a choice of 64 color palettes for the player ship and removes the background music while retaining sound effects. The original stages, enemies and scoring remain intact.
tips: Press left or right during ship selection to change the ship palette.

games.title: DoDonPachi Dai-Ou-Jou (Black Label)
games.description: DoDonPachi Dai-Ou-Jou (Black Label) is Cave's updated 2002 edition of the vertical bullet-hell shoot-'em-up DoDonPachi Dai-Ou-Jou on PolyGame Master (PGM) hardware. It allows players to choose between a single-loop (1-ALL) or two-loop (2-ALL) game at the start, lets Hyper items carry over across lives, and adjusts rank progression and scoring balance.

games.title: DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou
games.description: DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou is a vertical-scrolling bullet-hell shoot-'em-up developed and published by Cave for the Cave CV1000-D arcade platform in 2012. As the final arcade installment in the DoDonPachi series, it features three playable Element Dolls with customizable Shot, Laser, and Expert outfits, a Hyper Overflow system that increases both firepower and enemy bullet density, and five stages culminating in the true final boss Hibachi.

games.title: Deathsmiles (Hidden Elements Full Open + Character Enhancement)

modifications.description: Unlocks hidden stage routes and boss content by default and enhances player character attack capabilities.

games.description: Deathsmiles (Hidden Elements Full Open + Character Enhancement) is a modified version of Cave's 2007 horizontal gothic shoot-'em-up Deathsmiles on Cave CV1000 hardware, unlocking secret elements and boosting character firepower.

games.title: Dilithium Lift
games.description: Dilithium Lift is a maze game by Arlasoft, released in 2023. Collect the crystals distributed through a grid of corridors while keeping track of the remaining lives.

games.title: Donkey Kong Barrelpalooza
games.description: Twelve barrel-board variants introduce challenges such as reversed routes, altered gravity and moving springs. Boards and difficulty levels are selected randomly, with optional fixed choices through DIP switches.

games.title: Donkey Kong Christmas Remix
games.description: Donkey Kong Christmas Remix gives Nintendo's arcade platformer a holiday makeover with winter-themed sprites, festive colors, and remixed stages built on the Braze expansion kit.

modifications.description: Replaces character, hazard, and stage visuals with Christmas-themed sprites and winter palettes.
Introduces remixed stage layouts on the Braze expansion kit.

games.title: Donkey Kong Pac-Man Crossover
games.description: Donkey Kong meets Pac-Man: collect every pellet before finishing each board. Power pellets temporarily turn Jumpman into an invincible Pac-Man who can chase the four ghosts.

games.title: Donkey Kong: Bowser's Takeover
games.description: Bowser replaces Donkey Kong in this Mario-themed variation. Avoid Piranha Plants, Koopas, Thwomps and lava, collecting three coins on each board to unlock its exit.

games.title: Donkey Kong 40th Anniversary Edition
games.description: An anniversary celebration gives the familiar Donkey Kong boards new layouts and party decorations. Guide Jumpman to Donkey Kong and Pauline, collecting presents and balloons along the way.

games.title: Donkey Kong Championship Edition
games.description: A tournament-oriented Donkey Kong variant that ends at a configurable earlier kill screen. Choose level 5, 7, 9 or 11; the bonus life is fixed at 7,000 points.

games.title: Donkey Kong Foundry
games.description: Donkey Kong Foundry expands the original arcade game with a fifth board, the Foundry, alongside the four familiar stages. This modification by Jeff Kulczycki also adds an optional free-play mode that keeps the attract sequence running between games.

games.title: Donkey Kong (patched)
games.description: This Don Hodges patch corrects the bonus-timer calculation responsible for the level 22 kill screen in Donkey Kong. The original boards and gameplay remain intact, allowing a run to continue past the point where the unmodified game becomes unplayable.

games.title: Donkey Kong Tournament Edition
games.description: Donkey Kong Tournament Edition reworks the classic arcade stages and scoring challenges specifically for competitive high-score play on the Braze expansion hardware.

modifications.description: Adjusts stage flow and scoring challenges for competitive high-score tournaments.
Reworks board layouts on the Braze expansion kit.

games.title: Donkey Kong Remix
games.description:
Donkey Kong Remix is a modification of Nintendo's 1981 arcade platform game by John Kowalski, part of the Donkey Kong Remix series that also includes the Christmas and Spooky editions. As in the original, Jumpman climbs ladders, jumps barrels and other hazards, and races to the top of each board to rescue Pauline, but the boards come from a custom stage set instead of the original four.

The game runs on the Braze expansion kit used by the other Remix releases, which replaces the standard board data and allows a different sequence of stages with its own title screen.

modifications.description: Replaces the original stage layouts with remixed stages stored in the Braze expansion ROM.
Uses a custom title screen with its own artwork and a remix credit line.

research_notes: Individual stage designs, the exact number of boards and the release year of this specific edition were not verified against documentation; the on-screen credit reads 'Remixed 2015'.
Author attribution follows the other Remix releases and the Remix project site.

games.title: Donkey Kong Twisted Jungle
games.description:
Donkey Kong Twisted Jungle is a 2020 modification of Nintendo's Donkey Kong by Paul Goes in which Donkey Kong has carried Pauline off to his jungle. Jumpman must rescue her across five brand-new jungle-themed stages that replace the familiar construction-site boards.

The jungle is Donkey Kong's home ground, not Jumpman's: players must avoid falling coconuts, time their jumps between elevator platforms, watch for ground that disappears underfoot, clear away leaves and tubers and evade worms, snapjaws and birds. Bananas can be collected for extra bonus points. Because the stages and enemies are all new, routes learned on the original arcade game are of little use.

modifications.description: Replaces the four original boards with five new jungle-themed stages.
Redraws backgrounds, platforms and enemies with a jungle presentation, including a new title screen.
Introduces jungle enemies such as worms, snapjaws, birds and falling coconuts.
Adds disappearing ground, removable leaves and tubers, and bananas that award bonus points.

games.title: Donkey Kong Wizardry
games.description:
Donkey Kong Wizardry is a 2022 modification by Paul Goes that adds a touch of magic to Nintendo's Donkey Kong. Jumpman is a wizard trying to rescue his girlfriend, Witch Pauline, and has a spell that temporarily halts fireballs when they come too close. The spell can be used once on each board and is activated with the Player 2 button, so it has to be saved for the right moment.

The barrel board is built randomly each time, with more than three million possible layouts, the pies and elevator boards have new designs, and the rivets board uses an upgraded fireball spawning algorithm that makes the well-known Star and Weave patterns useless. With more pressure from the fireballs than in the original, the spell must be used wisely.

modifications.description: Recasts Jumpman as a wizard and Pauline as a witch.
Gives Jumpman a spell, triggered with the Player 2 button and usable once per board, that temporarily halts fireballs that come too close.
Builds the barrel board randomly (millions of possible layouts) and redesigns the pies and elevator boards.
Upgrades the fireball spawning on the rivets board so that the usual Star and Weave patterns no longer work.

games.title: Donkey Kong HeartHunt
games.description:
Donkey Kong HeartHunt is a 2022 modification by Paul Goes in which Pauline has placed three hearts on every board. Jumpman can only finish a board after grabbing all three of them. On the barrel and elevator boards, collecting the hearts makes the final ladder to Pauline appear; on the pies board it sets the retractable ladders in motion; and on the rivets board it breaks the chains that hold up Donkey Kong.

The collection requirement turns each familiar board into a route-planning problem, since the hearts must be reached without losing sight of the barrels, fireballs and other hazards of the original game.

modifications.description: Places three hearts on each board that must all be collected before the board can be finished.

Collecting the hearts triggers a board-specific change: a final ladder to Pauline appears on the barrel and elevator boards, the retractable ladders start moving on the pies board, and the chains holding Donkey Kong break on the rivets board.

games.title: Donkey Kong Reverse
games.description:
Donkey Kong Reverse is a 2019 modification by Paul Goes that lets players experience Nintendo's Donkey Kong in reverse. On the barrel, conveyor and elevator boards Jumpman starts at the top of the screen and has to reach Pauline's heart at the bottom, while on the rivets board he must plug the rivets back in instead of unplugging them.

In every board it is a little easier to jump over fireballs and firefoxes because they do not change direction when Jumpman leaps over them.

modifications.description: Starts Jumpman at the top of the barrel, conveyor and elevator boards and sends him down to Pauline's heart at the bottom.
On the rivets board the rivets must be plugged back in instead of removed.
Fireballs and firefoxes no longer change direction when jumped, making them slightly easier to avoid.

games.title: Donkey Kong On the Run
games.description:
Donkey Kong On the Run is a 2020 modification by Paul Goes in which Donkey Kong has not only kidnapped Pauline but also sabotaged the boards, because he is on the run. The sabotage includes randomly broken ladders, twice as many wild barrels, blinking hammers, closely spaced pies and extra springs placed in between the original ones.

These changes keep the familiar objective and controls but make the game much more brutal, so it is aimed at players who already know the original boards well.

modifications.description: Adds randomly broken ladders, blinking hammers, in-between springs and more closely spaced pies.
Doubles the number of wild barrels, making the game considerably harder.

games.title: Donkey Kong Into the Dark
games.description:
Donkey Kong Into the Dark is a 2020 modification by Paul Goes in which Donkey Kong unplugs the power source and the lights go out. Jumpman must complete the boards in the dark, with the lights flashing on briefly every few seconds so that the player can get their bearings.

The platforming itself is unchanged, so the challenge comes from remembering the layouts, hazards and timings of the original game while most of the screen is hidden.

modifications.description: Switches the lights off so that most of the playfield is hidden, with a brief flash of light every few seconds.
Forces players to complete the boards largely from memory.

games.title: Donkey Kong Randomized Edition
games.description:
Donkey Kong Randomized Edition is a 2020 modification by Paul Goes that randomizes the progression of Nintendo's Donkey Kong. Instead of the fixed sequence of boards, each new board is chosen at random: a random level between 1 and 5 and a random screen among barrels, pies, springs and rivets, without regard to what was selected before.

To be more interesting for skilled players the selection is not evenly distributed: higher levels and the barrel board come up more often. The boards themselves keep the original layouts, which sets this game apart from Donkey Kong RNDMZR, where the layout of every board is randomly generated.

modifications.description: Selects each board at random from a level between 1 and 5 and one of the barrel, pies, springs and rivets screens, independently of the previous choice.
Weights the selection toward the later levels and the barrel board: the distribution is L1 3.5%, L2 9%, L3 25%, L4 25%, L5 37.5%, and Barrels 50%, Pies 12.5%, Springs 25%, Rivets 12.5%.

games.title: Donkey Kong Freerun Edition
games.description: Donkey Kong Freerun Edition is a 2019 modification of Nintendo's Donkey Kong by Paul Goes. Its opening screen replaces the familiar sloping girders with flat platforms connected by many ladders, and Jumpman keeps the original climbing and jumping controls.

modifications.description: Presents the opening screen with a flat arrangement of girders joined by a dense network of ladders.

research_notes: The intent and complete list of changes (for example whether enemies are reduced or removed) could not be verified from local documentation; only the altered opening screen and board layouts were observed in play.

games.title: Donkey Kong Pace
games.description: Donkey Kong Pace adds score-tracking information to the original game. Its pace chart and calculations help players judge how their scoring compares with a longer run, while retaining the familiar boards and gameplay.

games.title: Donkey Kong RNDMZR
games.description: Randomly generated layouts reshape all four Donkey Kong board types while preserving the original movement and hazards. Each new board offers a different arrangement of platforms and ladders.

games.title: Donkey Kong Spooky Remix
games.description: Donkey Kong Spooky Remix transforms the arcade stages with a Halloween aesthetic featuring ghosts, pumpkins, bats, and Pauline dressed as a witch, alongside remixed board layouts.

modifications.description: Reskins sprites and stages with a Halloween theme featuring ghosts, pumpkins, bats, and Pauline dressed as a witch.
Introduces remixed stage layouts on the Braze expansion kit.
Adapts the rotary/positional control scheme for standard 8-way joystick input.

games.title: Double Dragon One
games.description: Double Dragon One is a homebrew side-scrolling beat-'em-up adaptation for the Neo Geo MVS developed by La Casa De Ruivo and Neo Byte Force in 2025.

modifications.description: Adapts the rotary/positional control scheme for standard 8-way joystick input.

games.title: Frog Feast
games.description: Frog Feast is a homebrew two-player action game developed by Rastersoft (Charles Doty) for the Neo Geo platform in 2006, inspired by classic frog-catching pond games where players leap across lily pads and use their tongues to catch flies.

games.title: Flappy Chicken
games.description: Flappy Chicken is a homebrew one-button arcade action game developed by Blastar for the Neo Geo MVS platform and released on April 30, 2023.

games.title: Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5 (Black Label Color)

modifications.description: Applies the palette and color scheme from Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label to Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5.

games.description: Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5 (Black Label Color) is a palette modification by ArcCabView for Cave's 2006 vertical shoot-'em-up Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5, importing the stage and sprite color palettes from the Black Label edition.

games.title: Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label - Another Ver (Original Color)

modifications.description: Restores the original Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5 color palettes in the international Another Ver release of Black Label.

games.description: Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label - Another Ver (Original Color) is a palette modification by ArcCabView for the international Another Ver release of Cave's Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label, restoring the original Ver 1.5 color palettes.

games.title: Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label (Original Color)

modifications.description: Restores the original Mushihime-Sama Futari Ver 1.5 color palettes in the Japanese Black Label release.

games.description: Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label (Original Color) is a palette modification by ArcCabView for the Japanese release of Cave's Mushihime-Sama Futari Black Label, restoring the original Ver 1.5 color palettes.

games.title: Galaga Wave Mixer
games.description: Galaga Wave Mixer randomizes the paths taken by incoming enemy waves, choosing from 24 routes with additional mirroring and timing variations. Some routes lead into the usual formation while others do not. Challenging Stages are also mixed, and each new game uses a different random seed.

games.title: Galaga Challenging Only
games.description: Galaga Challenging Only turns the game's bonus rounds into the entire playing experience. Shoot down incoming formations in successive Challenging Stages and aim for perfect clears. The normal combat stages are omitted, so the focus is on accuracy and learning the enemies' flight paths.

games.title: Galaga '84
games.description: Galaga '84 changes the title and alien graphics of Namco's fixed-screen shooter. Move a fighter along the bottom of the screen and destroy enemy formations as individual aliens break away to dive toward the player. The modified presentation retains the familiar Galaga scoring and combat structure.

games.title: Galaga (patched)

modifications.description: Corrects the stage 256 progression bug.

games.description: Don Hodges' Galaga patch corrects the bug that prevents normal progression at stage 256. It retains the original enemy formations, graphics, controls and scoring, allowing an extended run to continue beyond the affected stage.

games.title: Galaga Ghost

modifications.description: Replaces the insect-like aliens with Pac-Man ghosts (blue and red) and the Boss Galaga with yellow Pac-Man characters, including the attacking and attract-mode enemies; the player's fighter is unchanged.
Replaces the ship explosion sound with a Pac-Man style death sound.
Uses modified program ROMs for all three CPUs and new character and sprite graphics ROMs.

games.description:
Galaga Ghost is a graphical modification of Namco's 1981 fixed shooter Galaga that swaps the insect aliens for characters from Pac-Man. Move the fighter along the bottom of the screen and shoot the formation as it flies in, while individual enemies peel away to dive at you. Rows of blue and red ghosts make up the bulk of each formation, and yellow Pac-Man characters take the place of the Boss Galaga at the top; the enemies that attack also appear as ghosts and Pac-Man. The title screen still reads Galaga and the point values shown for the first two enemy types (50/100 and 80/160) are the same as the original.

The fighter keeps its original look, and the game plays as the familiar Galaga shoot-and-dodge. The one audible change is the explosion of the player's ship, which now plays a Pac-Man style death sound instead of the arcade's synthesized blast.
research_notes: The 2002 year and the attribution to Twisty come from a single source and are not independently confirmed.
Whether enemy behaviour, wave patterns or difficulty differ from Galaga was not established; one of the program ROMs is labelled 'fast' and may indicate a speed change.
The Pac-Man style ship explosion is played from an external sample file.

games.title: Ghost Hunt
games.description:
Ghost Hunt is a 2016 homebrew shooting-gallery game developed by Hurray Banana for original Pac-Man arcade hardware. Rather than reproducing Pac-Man's maze-chase gameplay, it presents a compact shooting challenge built around the capabilities of the vintage arcade board: the joystick steers a small tank across the screen while ghosts drift around the playfield, and the 1P Start button fires, with the goal of shooting as many ghosts as possible within 60 seconds. The game emphasizes simple arcade action and immediate player interaction, demonstrating how familiar hardware can support an entirely different kind of game.

Originally created as an educational exercise for students learning Z80 assembly language, Ghost Hunt was designed to show features such as addressing modes, interrupts, shifting, lookup tables and masking, and was released together with fully commented source code. It was written to run on actual Pac-Man hardware. Although it relies on the same electronic platform as Pac-Man, Ghost Hunt is an independent homebrew game rather than a modified version of the original maze adventure.
research_notes: The developer's testing on actual Midway Pac-Man hardware and the later revisions and bug fixes could not be confirmed from local evidence; the in-game text only states that the code is designed to run on actual Pac-Man hardware.

games.title: Maiya: Super Nature Girl
games.description:
Maiya: Super Nature Girl is a 2026 side-scrolling action-platform adventure developed by Eagle Software for the Neo Geo. Players explore a series of natural environments, running and jumping across platforms, climbing vines, discovering hidden items and confronting hostile creatures. Maiya can attack nearby enemies with a whip, throw thorns, dash through dangerous areas and use special nature-themed abilities. Collectible power-ups temporarily improve her movement or combat abilities, while flowers, rescued villagers and other treasures provide additional objectives along the way.

The adventure spans twelve missions featuring forests, coastlines, valleys and industrial environments. Stage exploration leads to encounters with powerful guardians, often fought in enclosed arenas where timing and positioning become especially important. Bonus sequences and hidden areas provide additional challenges between major encounters. The game's colorful scenery, animated characters and combination of platform exploration, combat and item collection establish it as an original adventure inspired by classic arcade platform games.

games.title: Maiya & Luna: Wonderful Adventures in Nature Fantasy
games.description:
Maiya & Luna: Wonderful Adventures in Nature Fantasy is a 2026 exploration and puzzle adventure developed by Eagle Software as a follow-up to Maiya: Super Nature Girl. Instead of concentrating on side-scrolling platform combat, it focuses on investigating interconnected locations, talking to characters, collecting useful objects and solving environmental puzzles. Players choose between two sisters whose different abilities create distinct routes through the adventure. Maiya can climb vegetation, move heavy obstacles and defend herself with a whip, while Luna specializes in examining details, navigating narrow passages and manipulating delicate mechanisms.

The story follows efforts to restore seven ancient wonders after a storm disrupts the valley's water systems. Its seven chapters take players through locations such as an abandoned watermill, a forest labyrinth, a lighthouse, a crystal grotto and a great tree observatory. Each sister follows her own journey through the shared world, with different discoveries, puzzles and conversations. The adventure emphasizes observation, exploration and cooperation over conventional arcade combat, with a notebook and inventory supporting progress through its interconnected challenges.

games.title: No Signal Z Alpha
games.description:
No Signal Z Alpha is a 2026 side-scrolling beat-'em-up developed by Eagle Software for the Neo Geo. After a stolen phone leaves the city without a signal, players choose one of three heroes, Jay, Zoe or Kai, and battle through eight stages to recover it. The adventure moves from city streets and underpasses to laboratories, industrial environments and increasingly futuristic locations, with different enemies and powerful bosses along the way. Each hero has a distinct fighting style and special attack: Jay favors quick combinations, Zoe uses agile movements and counters, while Kai relies on slower but stronger blows.

Combat combines punches, sweeps, aerial kicks, grabs, throws and special attacks that consume part of the character's health, represented as phone battery power. Players can break objects to reveal food and bonuses, collect weapons, and even ride an electric scooter through some encounters. The game's colorful urban environments, exaggerated characters and multi-stage boss fights evoke classic arcade beat-'em-ups while adding their own humor and science-fiction theme.

games.title: Panda Jump
games.description:
Panda Jump is a 2022 arcade homebrew platform game developed by Ben Larson for original Galaxian hardware. The player controls a panda attempting to retrieve his favorite bamboo by jumping from the bottom of the screen to the top. Moving platforms provide the only safe route across each stage, while deadly lava waits below. The game features nine increasingly challenging levels that demand precise timing, careful landings, and an understanding of the character's momentum.

Unlike conventional platform games with instantaneous movement, Panda Jump rewards anticipating the motion of platforms and controlling momentum while jumping and landing. Later stages require players to build speed to reach otherwise inaccessible platforms. Developed as a spin-off of Larson's Panky the Panda, it transforms classic arcade hardware into a demanding game of precision jumping, where mastering movement is the key to survival.

games.title: Seraph Zero
games.description:
Seraph Zero is a 2026 vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up created by Nasprich for the Neo Geo. Players pilot one of six spacecraft through seven stages of intense aerial combat, fighting enemy formations, dodging incoming fire and confronting large bosses. Each stage contains two distinct areas, a mid-stage encounter and a final boss, with environments ranging from oceans and jungles to deserts, orbital installations and mechanical fortresses. Hidden passages and secret areas reward players who master the hazards and special challenges found throughout the adventure.

The six pilots have individual spacecraft, special bombs, abilities and fully voiced personalities. Players can collect and upgrade six types of weapons, including spread shots, piercing lasers, homing missiles and attacks capable of neutralizing enemy projectiles. The game supports simultaneous two-player cooperative action or a computer-controlled wingman, with character relationships developing through their shared experiences. Additional modes include Boss Rush, Practice and Score Attack, while achievements and unlockable gallery content provide incentives for repeated play. Seraph Zero also supports both vertical and horizontal display configurations, making its elaborate arcade-shooter experience accessible on different Neo Geo setups.

games.description: Street Fighter Zero 3 Mix is an extensive gameplay overhaul and technical enhancement of Capcom's 1998 CPS-2 fighting game Street Fighter Zero 3, developed by Zero800. Running on the custom CPS2Turbo architecture with overclocked 68000 and Z80 processors, the hack introduces native 16:9 widescreen rendering, high-fidelity stereo music samples, and 3-on-3 team battle modes. Combat is comprehensively rebalanced with Just Defend parry mechanics, super canceling, projectile collisions, simplified motion inputs, mid-fight character transformations, and updated movesets across the roster.

games.title: Shadow League Fighting
games.description:
Shadow League Fighting is a 2026 two-dimensional fighting game developed by Eagle Software for the Neo Geo AES and MVS. Its roster contains 44 original combatants with individual appearances, fighting techniques, special attacks and super moves. Players can enter traditional one-on-one duels or three-versus-three team battles, where each side selects a separate striker who can briefly enter the fight to assist. The combat system includes throws, evasive maneuvers, guarding, dashes, special-move combinations and powerful attacks activated through directional inputs.

Matches unfold in colorful arenas with animated backgrounds, character portraits, announcer calls and individual victory presentations. Fighters can link ordinary attacks into special moves, while team matches introduce tactical decisions about character order and when to call a striker. Computer opponents offer multiple difficulty levels, and a training mode provides opportunities to practice commands and combinations. Its substantial cast, team mechanics and elaborate presentation make Shadow League Fighting an ambitious original contribution to the Neo Geo fighting-game library.

games.description:
Tempest CAX 2026 is a modified edition of Atari's vector arcade shooter Tempest, listed as version 1.2. As in the original, you control a claw-shaped blaster that moves around the rim of a geometric tube, shooting the enemies that climb toward you from the far end while avoiding collisions, and you can trigger the Superzapper as an emergency weapon.

The edition keeps the original vector presentation and controls but changes how a game begins. Its skill-select screen offers the first five levels in sequence (1 to 5) rather than the original's every-other-level choices (1, 3, 5, 7 and 9), with correspondingly smaller starting bonuses. The attract mode and skill-select screens carry a 'SHUPAC 2026 CAX' credit in place of the Atari copyright line, and the high score table starts with different entries.

games.title: Veil Riot
games.description:
Veil Riot is a 2026 arcade action shooter developed by theSEGAshop for the Neo Geo AES and MVS. Players prepare and customize their combat machines in an underground workshop before entering dangerous urban districts populated by rival pilots. Combat combines movement, weapons and tactical abilities, including a cloaking system that allows players to conceal their position and sonar pulses that help locate opponents. The objective is not simply to defeat every enemy, but to survive encounters, collect money and escape through an exit gate before the pursuing Warden arrives.

Five scrolling city districts contain moving traffic, hazardous machinery, automated defenses and opponents with different fighting tactics. Between encounters, players return to a hub where shops offer weapons, mechanical upgrades, tuning and cosmetic customization, alongside additional activities such as a music shop and arcade minigames. A seasonal competition structure introduces recurring challenges and powerful rivals, while two-player versus battles provide another way to play. Veil Riot was released publicly in a playable but unfinished state, offering an ambitious mixture of vehicular combat, tactical encounters and persistent progression while development continues.

games.title: Violent Vengeance: The Universe Hero
games.description: Violent Vengeance: The Universe Hero adapts Accend's 1995 MS-DOS fighting game to Neo Geo with a new engine and revised combat. Choose from ten fighters, each with a distinct stage and special moves, and face opponents in one-on-one bouts, including two non-playable bosses. This beta 3.28 release retains the project's humorous presentation while expanding its arcade fighting system.

games.title: Warrior Man
games.description:
Warrior Man is a 2026 Neo Geo homebrew action game developed by Nico Klem under the NK Home Entertainment name. Set in a city threatened by criminal gangs and other dangers, it follows Marius and Lisa as they search for Marius's missing girlfriend, Lena. Rather than following a single arcade genre, the game combines three distinct modes within one project. Fight mode is a side-scrolling beat-'em-up featuring punches, kicks, guarding, jumps and a powerful Storm Attack, with enemies, environmental obstacles and bosses encountered across several stages.

Shoot mode changes the action into a horizontally scrolling space shooter, placing the player aboard the Thunder DWS against alien fleets, large warships and powerful bosses. Charged shots, upgradeable satellite weapons and screen-clearing attacks add depth to the combat. Road mode offers a contrasting arcade racing experience with pseudo-3D roads, curves, hills, traffic and different circuits. Combining street fighting, space combat and driving gives Warrior Man an unusual structure among Neo Geo homebrew productions, bringing several classic arcade experiences together in one evolving game.

games.title: World Racer
games.description: World Racer is a top-down racing game by Blastar. Compete against computer-controlled cars on a scrolling circuit, steering through bends and accelerating away from the starting grid. A course map shows the positions of the player and the opposing racers.

games.title: Xeno Crisis
games.description: Xeno Crisis is a one- or two-player top-down arena run-and-gun shooter developed and published by Bitmap Bureau for the Neo Geo MVS in 2019. Players control battle-hardened marines clearing procedurally arranged alien-infested outpost rooms using twin-stick style eight-way firing, dodge rolls, grenades, and temporary heavy weapons.

games.title: Yo-Yo Shuriken
games.description: Yo-Yo Shuriken is a single-screen shooter in which one or two ninjas defend a dojo against robots. Throw a single shuriken and recall it to strike enemies from behind, or charge the weapon to cut through several opponents at once. Seven stages combine waves of enemies with boss encounters, and two players can tackle them together.
